mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) signals robust economic growth, boosting corporate earnings expectations and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite a statistically significant upward trend in GDPC1 over the prior 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% triggers a recessionary environment, reducing corporate profits and consumer spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE exceeding 5.0% in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal a tightening monetary policy and weakening labor market, both of which depress equity valuations and generate negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite concurrent rises in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent peaks in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) above late-cycle thresholds signal an overvalued market, leading to diminished S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite both GDPC1 and INDPRO exceeding their respective thresholds, or the joint effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflationary spike in the CPIAUCSL index above 235.0 triggers higher interest rates, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite CPIAUCSL exceeding 235.0, or the inflationary impact is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in monthly job openings (PAYEMS) indicates a robust labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate investment, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive despite a statistically significant upward trend in PAYEMS over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand in the market for goods and services (RSAFS) coupled with a decline in federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, expanding credit availability and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative despite RSAFS rising and FEDFUNDS falling, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) signals a post-recession recovery, fostering investor optimism and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-positive despite UNRATE and FEDFUNDS meeting the recovery criteria, or the combined effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
